A property with a setter and no getter can be written but never read. `user.name = "Ada"` works, but `user.name` is `undefined`. Most of the time, someone forgot the getter.

The rule looks at object literals, classes, and the descriptors passed to `Object.defineProperty()`, `Object.defineProperties()`, `Object.create()` and `Reflect.defineProperty()`. A getter without a setter is a read-only property, so it's allowed by default.

{/* Generated by src/codegen/lint-rule-docs.ts. Do not edit this section. */}

## Configure

Off by default. To turn it on:

```toml bunfig.toml
[lint.rules]
"accessor-pairs" = "error" # or "warn"
```

Every option, set to its default:

```toml bunfig.toml
[lint.rules]
"accessor-pairs" = ["error", {
  setWithoutGet = true,
  getWithoutSet = false,
  enforceForClassMembers = true,
  enforceForTSTypes = false,
}]
```

{/* End of the generated section. */}

## Examples

Reported:

{/* bad */}
```js
const user = {
  set name(value) {
    this._name = value.trim();
  },
};
```

{/* bad */}
```js
Object.defineProperty(user, "name", {
  set(value) {
    this._name = value.trim();
  },
});
```

Not reported:

{/* good */}
```js
const user = {
  get name() {
    return this._name;
  },
  set name(value) {
    this._name = value.trim();
  },
};

const config = {
  get version() {
    return 3;
  },
};
```

## Options

| Option | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `setWithoutGet` | `true` | Report a setter that has no getter. |
| `getWithoutSet` | `false` | Report a getter that has no setter. |
| `enforceForClassMembers` | `true` | Also check classes. A static accessor only pairs with a static one. |
| `enforceForTSTypes` | `false` | Also check TypeScript interfaces and object types. |

{/* bad {"options": [{"getWithoutSet": true}]} */}
```js
const config = {
  get version() {
    return 3;
  },
};
```

{/* good {"options": [{"enforceForClassMembers": false}]} */}
```js
class User {
  set name(value) {
    this._name = value.trim();
  }
}
```

{/* bad {"options": [{"enforceForTSTypes": true}]} */}
```ts
interface User {
  set name(value: string);
}
```
